CheckTitle: SQL Server has Advanced Data Security enabled
Description: **Azure SQL Server** instances are evaluated for the server-level **security alert policy** of **Advanced Data Security**, expecting the policy state to be `Enabled`.
Risk: Without **Advanced Data Security**, anomalous logins, SQL injection patterns, and risky configurations may go undetected, enabling data exfiltration (**confidentiality**), unauthorized changes (**integrity**), and disruptive queries (**availability**).

Code.Other:
1. Sign in to the Azure portal > SQL servers > select <SERVER_NAME>
2. Under Security, select Microsoft Defender for Cloud or Security Alerts
3. Toggle to On (Enable) and click Save

Recommendation.Text: Enable **Advanced Data Security** across all Azure SQL servers to detect anomalous activities and potential threats.
